name: Violet Lespedeza
desc: Violet Lespedeza (Lespedeza violacea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Lespedeza violacea, commonly known as wand lespedeza or violet lespedeza, is a species of herbaceous plant in the legume family. It is native to eastern North America, where it is widespread.
